meta.note: contributions are capped/conditional POINTS per signal (they sum to net_score); raw_signals are the uncapped harvested values. data_interp_split (row 3) and literary_analysis (row 10) score 0 for every article: both are pending (no keyword fallback exists — §9 activation checklist), unblocked by bucket-labels.json (Plan 4) and vector-family-scores.json (Plan 5) — see raw_signals.data_interp_pending and setup/Issues.md #141. maps_diagrams (row 13) and religious_art (row 15) carry real harvested values as of this export.

manuscripts.label: Named manuscripts
manuscripts.weight: +2 per, capped +6; +8 flat for teachings/books of the Bible
manuscripts.caveat: fixed list; generic mention counts as 1

journal_or_book.label: Journal/book citations
journal_or_book.caveat: merged signal — journal and book citations each cap independently at +2

balanced_debate.label: Balanced debate in interpretation sections
balanced_debate.weight: +2 per, capped +6; doubled to +12 when 2+ named representatives cited

ancient_historians.label: Non-Christian ancient historians
ancient_historians.caveat: 8-name list incl. Mara bar Serapion, Lucian, Celsus, Phlegon

confessional_balance.label: Confessional balance
confessional_balance.caveat: vector-classified (§3.1.8, reuses balanced-debate store); fires when a critical-scholarship historian is cited: -3 outside interpretation sections, -1 inside without an Evangelical counterpart, 0 with one

gnostic_over_emphasis.label: Gnostic over-emphasis
gnostic_over_emphasis.caveat: vector-classified (§3.1.10); dormant keyword fallback reads as the -2 tier

jesus_seminar.label: Jesus Seminar citations
jesus_seminar.weight: -3 per, capped -6; x2 outside interpretation, x0.5 if interpretation-only; further -2 if balanced debate scored 0
jesus_seminar.caveat: vector-classified (§3.1.6); stance-blind — placement and balance act as structural proxies (§11.3)

supernatural_criticism.label: Supernatural-worldview criticism
supernatural_criticism.caveat: vector-classified (§3.1.3); Miracle- and Passion-scoped, absorbs the old miracle-specific signal

other_religion.label: Other-religion sources
other_religion.caveat: Islamic, Mormon, Buddhist, Hindu, Sikh, Jain, Rastafari, Baha'i material cited as authoritative

mythicist.label: Mythicist citations
mythicist.weight: -3 per, capped -7; x2 outside interpretation, x0.5 if interpretation-only; further -2 if balanced debate scored 0
mythicist.caveat: vector-classified (§3.1.5); stance-blind — placement and balance act as structural proxies (§11.3)

referencing_quality.label: Referencing quality
referencing_quality.weight: -9 at 0 refs / +3 at 1-4 / +1 at 5-9 / 0 at 10+; further -1 for poor referencing
referencing_quality.caveat: absorbs the former no-references, poor-referencing, and niche-exposure signals

literary_analysis.label: Literary analysis
literary_analysis.caveat: vector-classified (§3.1.9); no dormant fallback — genuinely new signal

religious_art.label: Religious art
religious_art.weight: -1 picture without diagram/map / +1 picture with one
religious_art.caveat: does not fire for parable/teaching articles; raised sensitivity on is_passion (§3.9)

secular_materialist.label: Secular-materialist presuppositions
secular_materialist.caveat: vector-classified (§3.1.7); Miracle- and Passion-scoped, no placement multiplier; dormant fallback shares the supernatural-criticism keyword detector
